items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: he played tuba with us... we'd travel around Mississippi and parts of Louisiana with Ridgely

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm telling you, I never dreamed, you know you take what's happening now in the beautiful highway and stuff and taking them days and all the time and see how a place was traveling, you just can't hardly realize it you know. Now you're traveling with a nice bus, heated, you know, cooling system in it, or automobile with heat in it. Yeah, get a flat tire, you have a sweats light, something like that. I remember, I think in Punctitura, we were in front of the station, it was snowing and we was changing the…
Can you tell us a little bit more about Ridgely's band, how they split up to East Salastan?
